## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Added or updated tests (bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] A failed or unsupported source shows as unavailable/skipped, never as an empty "all clear"
- [ ] New data sources set `attribution` and `licence` and respect the provider's terms
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or scraped listing data in the diff
- [ ] Score-affecting changes keep each component's plain-language reason accurate
- [ ] Updated the README or docs if behaviour or setup changed
